plain: Mercy or leniency, especially in punishment

webster.text: Mildness of temper; softness; tenderness; mercy.

example.quote: There can be no danger of too much lenity in legislative pardons, as the Senate must con concur, & the President moreover can require 2/3 of both Houses.
example.cite: James Madison, Notes of Debates in the Federal Convention of 1787, September 15, 1787
